one_line: Founding king of the Kamarupa Pala line, chosen by regional chiefs to stabilise the Brahmaputra valley after Tyagasimha’s heirless death.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, tall and lean with a disciplined, athletic build
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes under strong brows, a trimmed moustache and light beard along the jawline; default expression is calm, observant and composed, with a faint confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and gathered into a high knot at the back of the crown, secured with a simple gold cylindrical hairpin; front hair smoothed back with no fringe, a few controlled strands at the temples.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, finely woven off-white cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and crossing the chest, its borders woven with narrow red and black geometric stripes inspired by early Assamese patterns; beneath, a fitted, elbow-length-sleeved, pale cream cotton angarkha-style tunic that reaches mid-thigh and ties slightly to the left, and a reddish-ochre cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated to the ankles with a wide front pleat, the hem edged with a thin dark green stripe; around his waist is a broad dark brown leather belt over a cloth kamarband in muted maroon, from which hangs a small knife sheath and cloth pouch; he wears simple gold ear studs, a single flat gold neck torque, and a beaded armlet on his right arm; on his feet are dark brown leather sandals with toe loops; overall textiles are matte cotton with subtle woven texture, no silk ostentation, reflecting a regional chief elevated to kingship rather than a long-established imperial monarch.
appearance.signature: A medium-length straight iron sword with a slightly widening tip, simple crossguard and wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt at his left hip, often resting lightly in his right hand when he stands in council.

ref_desc: Brahma Pala is a mid-30s, tall, lean man with a medium-brown complexion, trimmed moustache and jawline beard, black hair in a high knot with a gold hairpin, wearing an off-white uttariya over a cream tunic and reddish-ochre dhoti with maroon waistband, simple gold jewellery, dark brown sandals, and a plain-guard iron sword in a dark brown leather scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Brahma Pala, founder of the Kamarupa Pala line: a mid-30s, tall, lean man with a medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, strong brows, a trimmed moustache and light beard along the jawline, and thick black hair oiled into a high knot at the back of the crown held by a simple gold cylindrical pin, with the front hair smoothed back and a few subtle strands at the temples. Dress him in a historically plausible c. 900–1000 CE Brahmaputra valley outfit: a finely woven off-white cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and crossing his chest, bordered with narrow red and black geometric stripes, over a pale cream cotton angarkha-style tunic with elbow-length sleeves reaching mid-thigh and tied slightly to the left, and a reddish-ochre cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a wide front pleat and a thin dark green stripe at the hem. Give him a broad dark brown leather belt over a muted maroon cloth waistband (kamarband), with a small knife sheath and cloth pouch hanging, simple gold ear studs, a flat gold neck torque, and a beaded armlet on his right arm; put dark brown leather sandals with toe loops on his feet. His signature weapon is a medium-length straight iron sword with a slightly widening tip, a plain crossguard and wooden hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip and sometimes rested lightly in his right hand. Use a palette of off-white, reddish-ochre, dark brown, muted maroon and black, and show him in a calm, composed stance suitable for repeated redrawing in many panels.
